text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks B, D, and A after gains does not show that I can predict what comes next; past price moves do not predict future returns.","I should judge each holding by its future prospects and its role in the whole portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price or by reluctance to admit a mistake.","Frequent account checks and trading can amplify emotional reactions. I should use a consistent plan and avoid acting just to lock in small gains or escape the discomfort of a loss."]}
